abstract: A baby boy who had a left facial mass detected on antenatal ultrasound was delivered by Caesarian section after foetal distress was detected. Imaging investigations by plain radiographs and MRI showed a large mass with calcifications, soft tissue, fat and fluid components. A total surgical excision was perfomed and histology examination showed teratoma with no malignant features. Two weeks postoperatively, there was rapid recurrence of the tumour with intracranial involvement and obstructive hydrocephalus shown on MRI. The tumour was inoperable at surgery and the baby subsequently died at 5 weeks of life. This case describes the clinical course and imaging features of a neonatal epignathus teratoma with malignant and aggressive features.
abstract_ja: 出生前超音波検査で左顔面の腫瘤が指摘された男児が、帝王切開で出生した。単純X線およびMRIでは、石灰化、軟部組織、脂肪および液体成分を伴う大きな腫瘤が示された。全切除術が施行され、病理組織学的検査では悪性所見のない奇形腫と診断された。術後2週間で腫瘍は急速に再発し、MRIでは頭蓋内浸潤と閉塞性水頭症が認められた。手術時には切除不能であり、児は生後5週で死亡した。本症例は、悪性かつ攻撃的な性質を示した新生児エピグナトゥス奇形腫の臨床経過と画像所見を示している。
